correctness.rationale: Self-contained exact classification by (a,b,t): min(a,b)<=1 or (2,2,t>=1) or (2,3,t=2) and transpose. Both necessity (edges ab-t, forest edge bound) and sufficiency (cycle-free small graphs) proved; one-vertex extension checks exhaust maximality including n=3,4. Independent graph-based union-find/one-vertex-extension enumeration for n=3..9 checks every bivariate coefficient over 349504 subsets; finite experiments are explicitly supplementary.

value.rationale: Complete two-parameter face and facet enumerators for the natural family of crown graphs (K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching) refine the induced-forest count by both bipartition occupancies. The first failure of purity at n=5 and n-5 absent maximal-face sizes for n>=6 give structural information not recoverable from known scalar acyclic numbers or the pure complete-bipartite boundary. The complement gives a complete minimal feedback-vertex-set size/count distribution.
